abilities.name: Smoke Screen

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.

catalog.name: Atlas
catalog.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
catalog.passiveDescription: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

abilities.name: Landslide
abilities.description: Bash enemies with an explosive sliding punch, repeat up to three times for a combo attack. Each hit in the three-punch combo increases the radius of the attack. Energy cost is reduced with each hit of Landslide. Install mods on the Landslide Fists to boost stats.

abilities.name: Tectonics
abilities.description: Summon a Bulwark rock-wall, activate again to send the rocks crashing toward the enemy. Bulwarks attacked by enemies release an area-of-effect Slash powered by the Health it has lost.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.description: Atlas' hardened gaze will fossilize foes increasing the damage they take, heal Rumblers, and create Petrified Bulwarks. When shattered, petrified enemies drop healing Rubble for Atlas.

abilities.name: Rumblers
abilities.description: Summon two elemental stone brawlers to the melee. Summoning petrifies enemies in close proximity to Atlas. When finished, Rumblers collapse into a pile of healing Rubble.

catalog.name: Banshee
catalog.description: Banshee's call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
catalog.passiveDescription: Banshee pierces the ears of enemies within a |RADIUS|m radius when casting Abilities, applying max <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status Effect. Additionally, Banshee's weapon noise is hushed.

abilities.name: Sonic Boom
abilities.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate attackers and reduce their Armor.

abilities.name: Sonar
abilities.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak points to everyone in your squad.

abilities.name: Silence
abilities.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies, limits their perception and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks, and renders them unable to activate their abilities.

abilities.name: Sound Quake
abilities.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground in a targeted area.

catalog.name: Banshee Prime
catalog.description: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.

catalog.name: Baruuk
catalog.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
catalog.passiveDescription: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

abilities.name: Elude
abilities.description: Dodge all incoming projectiles, but only while not attacking. Use again to deactivate this ability.

abilities.name: Lull
abilities.description: A calming wave slows enemies until they fall into a slumber. Enemies woken by damage will be confused and disoriented. Short-term amnesia means all waking enemies forget anything that happened before the lull.

abilities.name: Desolate Hands
abilities.description: Summon a bevy of orbiting daggers to seek out enemy guns, destroying them with a small explosion. Combine with Elude to double the range.

abilities.name: Serene Storm
abilities.description: With his Restraint eroded, Baruuk commands the Desert Wind to deliver powerful radial strikes with his fists and feet. Each moment commanding the storm restores his Restraint.

Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.

abilities.description: Skewer and hold a target, siphoning their health. Use again to hurl the victim damaging them and anyone near the impact site.

abilities.name: Shield Maiden
abilities.description: Raise Bonewidow's shield to block incoming forward damage, reflecting it back at attackers. While active, bash enemies with a Maiden's Kiss.

abilities.name: Firing Line
abilities.description: Sweep surrounding enemies into the line of fire and suspend them in air with a force beam.

abilities.name: Exalted Ironbride
abilities.description: Summon a devastating exalted blade.

catalog.name: Caliban
catalog.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
catalog.passiveDescription: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

abilities.name: Razor Gyre
abilities.description: Dash forward in a spinning vortex of death. Struck enemies are inflicted with <DT_SENTIENT_COLOR>Tau Status Effect, making them more vulnerable to all other status effects. abilities.name: Lethal Progeny
abilities.description: Cycle through Sentient unit types, then summon them to Caliban's side. Conculysts focus on raw melee damage. abilities.description: Exhale a deep breath of elemental destruction. Tap to cycle through elements, hold to cast. The chosen element applies to all of Chroma's abilities.

abilities.name: Elemental Ward

abilities.name: Vex Armor
abilities.description: Chroma fortifies squad Armor when his Shields are damaged or he kills an enemy with a melee weapon. He increases squad Weapon Damage when he loses Health or he kills an enemy with a ranged weapon, double the effect on weak point kills.

abilities.name: Effigy
abilities.description: Chroma turns his pelt into a massive sentry that strengthens nearby allies and engulfs enemies in elemental attacks.

Throw two Elemental Ammo Packs that instantly refill the active weapon's magazine, while granting the weapon an additional instance of the selected Elemental Damage and Status Effect. Reload clears the effect. Sniper Rifles gain extra damage.

Hold the ability to select the Elemental Damage type.

abilities.name: Evade
abilities.description: Jump backwards and become invisible for a short duration. Killing enemies on their Weak Points extends the duration and heals Cyte-09.

abilities.name: Neutralize
abilities.description: Summon the Neutralizer, Cyte-09’s exalted Sniper Rifle. Bullets ricochet off Weak Points to seek out other nearby Weak Points. Alt fire lobs a <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold grenade that completely freezes enemies.

catalog.name: Dagath
catalog.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
catalog.passiveDescription: There is a |PERCENT|% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be |ENERGY|% more effective on Dagath.

abilities.name: Wyrd Scythes
abilities.description: Wyrd Scythes surround Dagath and seek out nearby enemies. Those struck are slowed and suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect. The scythes also spread Doom and extend its duration.

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.description: Condemn nearby enemies to their doom. A portion of the damage Dagath deals is revisited upon them by a Wyrd Scythe. They also suffer <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage.

abilities.name: Grave Spirit

catalog.name: Dante
catalog.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
catalog.passiveDescription: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.

abilities.name: Noctua
abilities.description: Open Noctua, Dante's Exalted Tome, and unleash a tale of woe upon his enemies.

abilities.name: Light Verse
abilities.description: Dante's vitalizing composition grants him and his allies Overguard and restores their Health.

abilities.name: Dark Verse
abilities.description: Dante's composition draws blood from nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage upon them.

abilities.name: Final Verse
abilities.description:
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRIUMPH: Two Light Verses cast in succession invigorate allies with a buff that increases Health and grants Overguard. Kills and assists briefly regenerate Overguard.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. TRAGEDY: Two Dark Verses cast in succession attack enemies. Damage Over Time from Slash, Heat and Toxin Status Effects accumulates in a single blast.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. WORDWARDEN: A Light Verse followed by a Dark Verse supports allies with copies of Noctua. Noctua copies synchronize their attacks with their designated ally's attacks.
Dante must compose two other Verses before his Final Verse. PAGEFLIGHT: A Dark Verse followed by a Light Verse summons Paragrimms that swoop at enemies, making them vulnerable to Status Chance and Status Damage, as well as drawing enemy attacks away from allies.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.

abilities.name: Photon Strike
abilities.description: Drop a targeting beacon that calls in a devastating laser artillery strike. Deals doubled damage to enemies with Overguard.

abilities.name: Bastille
abilities.description:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.

catalog.name: Voidrig
catalog.description: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.

abilities.name: Necraweb
abilities.description: Hurl a canister of graviton fluids to create a wide mire that will significantly slow enemies traveling across it. Alternatively, the canister can be shot in mid-air to create a fiery conflagration.

abilities.name: Storm Shroud
abilities.description: Swathe the Necramech in a powerful electrical field that greatly enhances survivability in close combat. Enemies that strike the shroud will suffer for their impudence.

abilities.name: Gravemines
abilities.description: Launch a pattern of charged mines all around you. Each mine detonates in a violent blast when touched, damaging enemies in a three-meter radius.

abilities.name: Guard Mode
abilities.description: Take a stationary stance to deploy maximum firepower and gain increased structural integrity for a time.

catalog.name: Volt
catalog.description: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
catalog.passiveDescription: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Speed
abilities.description: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.

abilities.name: Electric Shield
abilities.description:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.description: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.

catalog.name: Volt Prime
catalog.description: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.

catalog.name: Voruna
catalog.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
catalog.passiveDescription: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.

abilities.name: Shroud Of Dynar
abilities.description:
(TAP) Dynar shrouds Voruna with invisibility and accelerates her speed. Invisibility ends when Voruna attacks. For a short time after invisibility ends, melee attacks have increased Critical Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance and inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects. Melee kill an enemy during this time to extend the melee buff once per cast.

(HOLD) Dynar guards Voruna, increasing her Parkour Velocity.

abilities.name: Fangs Of Raksh
abilities.description:
(TAP) Raksh's fangs tear into your enemies. 5 random Status Effects are applied at 10 Stacks each on an enemy. On target's death, spread the Status Effects to other nearby enemies.

(HOLD) Raksh guards Voruna with Status Effect resistance.

abilities.name: Lycath's Hunt
abilities.description:
(TAP) Lycath hunts to sustain the pack. Enemies killed by melee attacks drop health orbs and enemies killed by headshots drop energy orbs. Increase the duration of Lycath's hunt by killing enemies affected by 5 or more Status Effects.

(HOLD) Lycath guards Voruna with increased Heavy Attack efficiency.

abilities.name: Ulfrun's Descent
abilities.description:
(TAP) Voruna drops to all fours and prepares 5 brutal charges that lock onto enemies. Ulfrun, the most powerful wolf, leads the attack as Voruna dashes toward her target. The pack deals increased damage to targets and nearby enemies that are inflicted by Status Effects. Lethal attacks double the damage of Voruna's remaining charges.

(HOLD) Ulfrun guards Voruna. If Voruna falls during this time, Ulfrun dies in her place.

catalog.name: Voruna Prime
catalog.description: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
catalog.passiveDescription: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf's unique Passive power.

catalog.name: Wisp
catalog.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
catalog.passiveDescription: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

abilities.name: Reservoirs
abilities.description: Choose and summon a Reservoir filled with Motes that attach to and aid Wisp and her allies. Haste Mote grants increased movement and attack speed. Vitality Mote increases maximum health and heals over time. Shock Mote stuns nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Wil-O-Wisp
abilities.description: Cast forward a spectral image of Wisp to confuse and distract enemies. Reactivate to travel to its position. Hold to have the image travel faster and teleport to its position on release.

abilities.name: Breach Surge
abilities.description:
Open a dimensional breach to overwhelm nearby enemies and cause them to release aggressive Surge sparks when damaged.
Wisp may also target a Reservoir to teleport to it and double the range of the surge.

abilities.name: Sol Gate
abilities.description: Open a portal to the sun to irradiate enemies with a devastating beam of pure solar plasma. Hold fire to double Damage at the cost of increased energy consumption. For the duration of an attack enemies damaged by Sol Gate are increasingly more vulnerable to it.

catalog.name: Wisp Prime
catalog.description: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.

catalog.name: Wukong
catalog.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
catalog.passiveDescription: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

abilities.name: Celestial Twin
abilities.description:
Shedding part of himself, Wukong creates a twin to fight by his side. Attack at range and the twin will melee, pull a blade and the twin will lay down covering fire.
Use again to command the twin to attack a target with increased damage.

abilities.name: Cloud Walker
abilities.description: Evaporate into a cloud of mist and float through the battlefield, dazing any enemies encountered, while healing Wukong and his twin.

abilities.name: Defy
abilities.description:
Wukong and his twin become invulnerable and defy enemies to attack. All damage is captured, stored, and dealt back in a single furious strike of Wukong's staff.
Bonus Armor is then granted relative to the damage captured.

abilities.name: Primal Fury
abilities.description: Summon the iron staff and unleash fury.

catalog.name: Wukong Prime
catalog.description: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.

catalog.name: Xaku
catalog.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
catalog.passiveDescription: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.

abilities.name: Xata's Whisper
abilities.description: Wield <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage for all attacks from equipped weapons when activated.

abilities.name: Grasp Of Lohk
abilities.description: Void Tendrils steal weapons from nearby enemies to use as your own floating, auto-targeting armament. Damage output increases based on enemy level. The number of weapons grabbed also determines the damage multiplier for The Lost: Deny's Void beam.

abilities.name: The Lost
abilities.description: Cycle through a trio of lost Warframe powers. Accuse manifests a Void fissure to corrupt enemies into allies. Gaze grasps targets in Void tendrils that capture damage and inflict it when the target is released. Deny annihilates with a beam of Void energy, wiping Sentient resistances.

abilities.name: The Vast Untime
abilities.description: Temporarily shed the outer pieces of Xaku in a destructive blast, then stalk the battlefield in a new, swifter skeletal form. Enemies damaged by the body shrapnel are rendered weaker to <DT_RADIANT_COLOR>Void Damage. Xaku's other active abilities' duration is frozen in time and resumes once The Vast Untime expires.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Complete Heart of Deimos

Deimos/Cambion Drift (Level 15 - 25 Cambion Drift Bounty), Rotation A
Deimos/Cambion Drift (Level 30 - 40 Cambion Drift Bounty), Rotation A

catalog.name: Yareli
catalog.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
catalog.passiveDescription: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.

abilities.name: Sea Snares
abilities.description:
Form five water globules that seek out enemies and expand on contact, simultaneously damaging and immobilizing their victims.
Enemies hit by the globules take increased damage from all sources.

abilities.name: Merulina
abilities.description: Summon Merulina, a rideable creature of the waves, and the inspiration for K-Driving. Merulina protects Yareli by absorbing a large portion of incoming damage.

abilities.name: Aquablades
abilities.description: Tear through foes with a trio of orbiting aquatic blades.

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.description: Drag enemies into a crushing maelstrom and then blow them away in a watery burst. Each enemy trapped in the vortex increases the burst's damage.

catalog.name: Yareli Prime
catalog.description: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.

catalog.name: Zephyr
catalog.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
catalog.passiveDescription: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.

abilities.name: Tail Wind
abilities.description: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.

abilities.name: Airburst
abilities.description: Launch a burst of massively dense air. Hold to send enemies flying, tap to pull them toward the burst. Damage increases per enemy hit.

abilities.name: Turbulence
abilities.description: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.

abilities.name: Tornado
abilities.description: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.

catalog.name: Zephyr Prime
catalog.description: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.

catalog.name: Acceltra
catalog.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.

catalog.name: Acceltra Prime
catalog.description: Engage your enemies with deadly speed. This weapon reloads even faster when its wielder sprints, faster still with Gauss.

catalog.name: Aeolak
catalog.description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.

drops.location: Zariman Ten Zero (Level  110 - 115 Zariman Bounty), Rotation C

catalog.name: Afentis
catalog.description: Styanax's speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.

catalog.name: Afentis Prime
catalog.description: The gilded speargun of Styanax Prime shines like a beacon across the battlefield, invigorating allies and stunning enemies.

catalog.name: Alternox
catalog.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.

drops.location: Zariman Ten Zero (Level  70 - 75 Zariman Bounty), Rotation C

catalog.name: Alternox Prime
catalog.description: Orokin gold enhances the conductivity of Gyre Prime's signature rifle, enabling it to fire massive electrifying orbs.

catalog.name: Ambassador
catalog.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.

catalog.name: Amprex
catalog.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.

catalog.name: Arca Plasmor
catalog.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

catalog.name: Argonak
catalog.description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.

catalog.name: Astilla
catalog.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.

catalog.name: Astilla Prime
catalog.description: Loose explosive glass slugs that tear through enemies with Gara’s signature shotgun, presented here in its spectacular Prime form.

catalog.name: Attica
catalog.description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.

catalog.name: Ax-52
catalog.description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.

catalog.name: Basmu
catalog.description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.

catalog.name: Battacor
catalog.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.

catalog.name: Baza
catalog.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

catalog.name: Baza Prime
catalog.description: This rapid-fire classic is the Orokin-engineered definition of silent, pinpoint lethality.

catalog.name: Boar
catalog.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

catalog.name: Boar Prime
catalog.description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.

catalog.name: Boltor
catalog.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

catalog.name: Boltor Prime
catalog.description: Fires Orokin designed bolts that are faster and sharper.

catalog.name: Braton
catalog.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

catalog.name: Braton Prime
catalog.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.

catalog.name: Braton Vandal
catalog.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

catalog.name: Bubonico
catalog.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

catalog.name: Burston
catalog.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

catalog.name: Burston Prime
catalog.description: Once thought lost to the ages, attempts to reengineer the Burston Prime never fully replicated this weapon's power and agility.

catalog.name: Buzlok
catalog.description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.

catalog.name: Carmine Penta
catalog.description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.

catalog.name: Cedo
catalog.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire's precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.

catalog.name: Cedo Prime
catalog.description: A golden shotgun, forged for those who deliver judgment.

catalog.name: Cernos
catalog.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.

catalog.name: Cernos Prime
catalog.description: A noble bow to hunt hellish beasts.

catalog.name: Cinta
catalog.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

catalog.name: Coda Bassocyst
catalog.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

catalog.name: Coda Bubonico
catalog.description: With increased magazine size, the Coda Bubonico was born of the Technocyte virus' need to spread infection. Primary Fire rate ramps up with continuous fire.

catalog.name: Coda Hema
catalog.description: The Technocyte virus did nothing but increase the Hema’s thirst for blood. With increased Fire Rate, Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

catalog.name: Coda Sporothrix
catalog.description: Delivers a virus-laden barb to its victim that continues to damage it before exploding. With increased Damage, Reload Speed, Magazine Size, Status Chance, and explosion radius.

catalog.name: Coda Synapse
catalog.description: Firing a nonstop stream of vile corrosive gastric juice, the Coda Synapse comes with increased Magazine size, Beam Length, Status Chance, Punch Through, and Damage.

catalog.name: Convectrix
catalog.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

catalog.name: Corinth
catalog.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

catalog.name: Corinth Prime
catalog.description: Heavy in the hand with a bone-crunching kickback. This Prime version of this shotgun adds remote detonation of the weapon's airburst round.

catalog.name: Daikyu
catalog.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.

catalog.name: Daikyu Prime
catalog.description: Long believed lost, the mighty Daikyu Prime was the pride of many a Tenno dojo. Designed to strike the foe where they are weakest, its powerful shots repay careful marksmanship.

catalog.name: Dera
catalog.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.

catalog.name: Dera Vandal
catalog.description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

catalog.name: Dex Sybaris
catalog.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the third anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

catalog.name: Drakgoon
catalog.description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

catalog.name: Dread
catalog.description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.

catalog.name: Efv-5 Jupiter
catalog.description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.

catalog.name: Enkaus
catalog.description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

catalog.name: Evensong
catalog.description:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

catalog.name: Exergis
catalog.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

catalog.name: Felarx
catalog.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

catalog.name: Ferrox
catalog.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.

catalog.name: Flux Rifle
catalog.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.

catalog.name: Fulmin
catalog.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.

catalog.name: Fulmin Prime
catalog.description: Wield a storm. Fulmin Prime's electric rounds switch between lightning beams and short-range bursts. Wisp quickly swaps between each mode with her elemental prowess.

catalog.name: Glaxion
catalog.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

catalog.name: Glaxion Vandal
catalog.description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.

catalog.name: Gorgon
catalog.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

catalog.name: Gorgon Wraith
catalog.description: The Gorgon Wraith is a powerful variant of its precursor that features unique styling.

catalog.name: Gotva Prime
catalog.description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.

catalog.name: Grakata
catalog.description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.

catalog.name: Grinlok
catalog.description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

catalog.name: Haalvu
catalog.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

catalog.name: Harpak
catalog.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

catalog.name: Hek
catalog.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

catalog.name: Hema
catalog.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

catalog.name: Higasa
catalog.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

catalog.name: Hind
catalog.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.

catalog.name: Ignis
catalog.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.

catalog.name: Ignis Wraith
catalog.description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.

catalog.name: Javlok
catalog.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

catalog.name: Karak
catalog.description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.

catalog.name: Karak Wraith
catalog.description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.

catalog.name: Kohm
catalog.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

catalog.name: Komorex
catalog.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.

catalog.name: Kuva Bramma
catalog.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of clusterbomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.

catalog.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
catalog.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

catalog.name: Kuva Drakgoon
catalog.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

catalog.name: Kuva Hek
catalog.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.

catalog.name: Kuva Hind
catalog.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic fire modes.

catalog.name: Kuva Karak
catalog.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.

catalog.name: Kuva Kohm
catalog.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

catalog.name: Kuva Ogris
catalog.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casings semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot.

catalog.name: Kuva Quartakk
catalog.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.

catalog.name: Kuva Sobek
catalog.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.

catalog.name: Kuva Tonkor
catalog.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.

catalog.name: Kuva Zarr
catalog.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.

catalog.name: Lanka
catalog.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.

catalog.name: Latron
catalog.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.

catalog.name: Latron Prime
catalog.description: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.

catalog.name: Latron Wraith
catalog.description: The Latron Wraith is a powerful variation of the standard, semi-automatic rifle that features unique styling.

catalog.name: Lenz
catalog.description:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.

catalog.name: Miter
catalog.description: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.

catalog.name: Mk1-Braton
catalog.description: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.

catalog.name: Mk1-Paris
catalog.description: The MK1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Mk1-Strun
catalog.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

catalog.name: Mutalist Cernos
catalog.description: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.

catalog.name: Mutalist Quanta
catalog.description: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.

catalog.name: Nagantaka
catalog.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

catalog.name: Nagantaka Prime
catalog.description: A golden version of Garuda's versatile crossbow, as fashioned by the Orokin's finest weaponsmiths. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshot kills have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda the Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

catalog.name: Nataruk
catalog.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.

catalog.name: Nunchasa
catalog.description: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.

catalog.name: Ogris
catalog.description: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.

catalog.name: Opticor
catalog.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.

catalog.name: Opticor Vandal
catalog.description: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.

catalog.name: Panthera
catalog.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.

catalog.name: Panthera Prime
catalog.description: The max-velocity saw-launcher perfected. Features a larger magazine, faster fire rate, and a radial, slashing ricochet.

catalog.name: Paracyst
catalog.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.

catalog.name: Paris
catalog.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.

catalog.name: Paris Prime
catalog.description: Discovered deep inside an ancient Orokin derelict, the Paris Prime increases the kinetic energy of any bolt it fires, dealing more damage than its more common counterpart.

catalog.name: Penta
catalog.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.

catalog.name: Perigale
catalog.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession grant the Perigale Infinite Ammo. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.

catalog.name: Perigale Prime
catalog.description: The one who exalted Voruna to her Prime form imbued her signature sniper rifle with increased magazine size and ammo capacity, as if to arm her for a long hunt.

catalog.name: Phage
catalog.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.

catalog.name: Phantasma
catalog.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.

catalog.name: Phantasma Prime
catalog.description: Phantasma Prime is burnished with deadly force. In Revenant’s hands, it has increased magazine capacity. The might of its irradiated plasma is reminiscent of the fearsome Eidolon.

catalog.name: Phenmor
catalog.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

catalog.name: Prisma Gorgon
catalog.description: Adorned with void hardened prisma crystal, this Gorgon variant is prized for its beauty and enhanced mechanics.

catalog.name: Prisma Grakata
catalog.description: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.

catalog.name: Prisma Grinlok
catalog.description: Prisma-crystal enhancement creates here a prestige instrument; a weapon capable of taking life at astonishing range with but a single pull of its exquisitely-tooled trigger.

catalog.name: Prisma Lenz
catalog.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.

catalog.name: Prisma Tetra
catalog.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.

catalog.name: Proboscis Cernos
catalog.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.

catalog.name: Purgator 1
catalog.description: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.

catalog.name: Quanta
catalog.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.

catalog.name: Quanta Vandal
catalog.description: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

catalog.name: Quartakk
catalog.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.

catalog.name: Quellor
catalog.description: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.

catalog.name: Rakta Cernos
catalog.description: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.

catalog.name: Rauta
catalog.description: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.

catalog.name: Reconifex
catalog.description: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.

catalog.name: Rubico
catalog.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.

catalog.name: Rubico Prime
catalog.description: For the hunter, the apex of the sniper's art. For the hunted, a gateway to the next life.

catalog.name: Sancti Tigris
catalog.description: Echo nature's violent beauty with this special Tigris.

catalog.name: Scourge
catalog.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.

catalog.name: Scourge Prime
catalog.description: Smite the unrighteous with Harrow Prime's signature speargun.

catalog.name: Secura Penta
catalog.description: Ruthless and efficient, just like the free-market.

catalog.name: Shedu
catalog.description: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.

catalog.name: Simulor
catalog.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.

catalog.name: Sirocco
catalog.description: A silent, pistol-style Amp for the Drifter. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.

catalog.name: Snipetron
catalog.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.

catalog.name: Snipetron Vandal
catalog.description: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

catalog.name: Sobek
catalog.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.

catalog.name: Soma
catalog.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.

catalog.name: Soma Prime
catalog.description: Known for taking down whole squads with its single massive magazine, few weapons were as feared as the Prime Soma.

catalog.name: Sporothrix
catalog.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

catalog.name: Stahlta
catalog.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.

catalog.name: Steflos
catalog.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.

catalog.name: Steflos Prime
catalog.description: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.

catalog.name: Stradavar
catalog.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.

catalog.name: Stradavar Prime
catalog.description: Between measured staccato and staggering crescendo, Stradavar Prime never fails to call down a devastating finale.

catalog.name: Strun
catalog.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

catalog.name: Strun Prime
catalog.description: A classic shotgun design, embellished for the elite as only the Orokin could.

catalog.name: Strun Wraith
catalog.description: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.

catalog.name: Supra
catalog.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

catalog.name: Supra Vandal
catalog.description: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.

catalog.name: Sybaris
catalog.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.

catalog.name: Sybaris Prime
catalog.description: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.

catalog.name: Synapse
catalog.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.

catalog.name: Synoid Simulor
catalog.description: Cephalon Suda's custom issue Simulor was built to satisfy her curiosity.

catalog.name: Telos Boltor
catalog.description: Bring down judgement, with this boltor crafted by the Arbiters of Hexis.

catalog.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
catalog.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

catalog.name: Tenet Envoy
catalog.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.

catalog.name: Tenet Ferrox
catalog.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.

catalog.name: Tenet Flux Rifle
catalog.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.

catalog.name: Tenet Glaxion
catalog.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.

catalog.name: Tenet Quanta
catalog.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.

catalog.name: Tenet Tetra
catalog.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.

catalog.name: Tenora
catalog.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

catalog.name: Tenora Prime
catalog.description: Add lethal staccato percussion to Octavia's melodies with this masterpiece assault rifle.

catalog.name: Tetra
catalog.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.

catalog.name: Thornbak
catalog.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.

catalog.name: Tiberon
catalog.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.

catalog.name: Tiberon Prime
catalog.description: Art meets ingenuity with this beautifully deadly rifle.

catalog.name: Tigris
catalog.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.

catalog.name: Tigris Prime
catalog.description: An artifact of exquisite beauty. A weapon of deadly purpose.

catalog.name: Tonkor
catalog.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.

catalog.name: Torid
catalog.description: Torid lobs a toxic payload.

catalog.name: Trumna
catalog.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.

catalog.name: Trumna Prime
catalog.description: Sleek lines and golden accents define this masterpiece of the illustrious Entrati family.

catalog.name: Vadarya Prime
catalog.description: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.

catalog.name: Vaykor Hek
catalog.description: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.

catalog.name: Vectis
catalog.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.

catalog.name: Vectis Prime
catalog.description: Once thought destroyed, the newly uncovered Vectis Prime revives Tenno martial traditions.

catalog.name: Veldt
catalog.description: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.

catalog.name: Vinquibus
catalog.description: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.

catalog.name: Vulkar
catalog.description: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.

catalog.name: Vulkar Wraith
catalog.description: A blood-red variant of this devastating sniper rifle.

catalog.name: Zarr
catalog.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.

catalog.name: Zenith
catalog.description: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Daily Tribute

catalog.name: Zhuge
catalog.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.

catalog.name: Zhuge Prime
catalog.description: Tenno artistry. Ancient craft. A weapon of surgical precision and devastating effect. Each bolt fired by Zhuge Prime explodes shortly after embedding.

catalog.name: Acrid
catalog.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.

catalog.name: Aegrit
catalog.description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.

catalog.name: Afuris
catalog.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.

catalog.name: Afuris Prime
catalog.description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.

catalog.name: Akarius
catalog.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

catalog.name: Akarius Prime
catalog.description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.

catalog.name: Akbolto
catalog.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.

catalog.name: Akbolto Prime
catalog.description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.

catalog.name: Akbronco
catalog.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

catalog.name: Akbronco Prime
catalog.description: Used together, these Orokin pistols feed off each other, inflicting greater damage with an enhanced status chance for inducing elemental effects on targets.

catalog.name: Akjagara
catalog.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

catalog.name: Akjagara Prime
catalog.description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.

catalog.name: Aklato
catalog.description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.

catalog.name: Aklex
catalog.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.

catalog.name: Aklex Prime
catalog.description: Savage the enemy with a Lex Prime in each hand.

catalog.name: Akmagnus
catalog.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.

catalog.name: Akmagnus Prime
catalog.description: Fill your fists with golden cannons of fury. This refined design unlocks quicker handling and higher critical chance.

catalog.name: Aksomati
catalog.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

catalog.name: Aksomati Prime
catalog.description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.

catalog.name: Aksondol
catalog.description: Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's bite. Reloading sends out a chilling pulse that inflicts Cold Status Effect, the pulse's range increases with each round reloaded.

catalog.name: Akstiletto
catalog.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

catalog.name: Akstiletto Prime
catalog.description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.

catalog.name: Akvasto
catalog.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.

catalog.name: Akvasto Prime
catalog.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.

catalog.name: Akzani
catalog.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

catalog.name: Angstrum
catalog.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.

catalog.name: Arca Scisco
catalog.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.

catalog.name: Athodai
catalog.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and giving Infinite Ammo for a short time.

catalog.name: Athodai Prime
catalog.description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on Weak Point kills, maximizing fire rate and giving Infinite Ammo for a short time.

catalog.name: Atomos
catalog.description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.

catalog.name: Azima
catalog.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Daily Tribute

catalog.name: Ballistica
catalog.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

catalog.name: Ballistica Prime
catalog.description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.

catalog.name: Bolto
catalog.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

catalog.name: Brakk
catalog.description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.

catalog.name: Bronco
catalog.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

catalog.name: Bronco Prime
catalog.description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.

catalog.name: Cantare
catalog.description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

catalog.name: Castanas
catalog.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

catalog.name: Catabolyst
catalog.description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.

catalog.name: Cestra
catalog.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.

catalog.name: Coda Catabolyst
catalog.description: When the magazine reaches empty and is manually reloaded, the Coda Catabolyst launches not one but three powerful grenades. Also has a higher Status Chance, Damage, and Magazine Size.

catalog.name: Coda Pox
catalog.description: These festering, writhing, throwable projectiles of pus and gas have been improved with a greater Magazine Size, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Status Chance, and Damage.

catalog.name: Coda Tysis
catalog.description: The Technocyte virus has contorted this Tysis into a more lethal weapon. With increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Magazine Capacity.

catalog.name: Cyanex
catalog.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.

catalog.name: Cycron
catalog.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

catalog.name: Despair
catalog.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

catalog.name: Detron
catalog.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

catalog.name: Dex Furis
catalog.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

catalog.name: Dual Cestra
catalog.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

catalog.name: Dual Coda Torxica
catalog.description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.

catalog.name: Dual Toxocyst
catalog.description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

catalog.name: Efv-8 Mars
catalog.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

catalog.name: Embolist
catalog.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

catalog.name: Epitaph
catalog.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

catalog.name: Epitaph Prime
catalog.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.

catalog.name: Euphona Prime
catalog.description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.

catalog.name: Furis
catalog.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

catalog.name: Fusilai
catalog.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

catalog.name: Gammacor
catalog.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

catalog.name: Grimoire
catalog.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

catalog.name: Grimoire
catalog.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

catalog.name: Hikou
catalog.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

catalog.name: Hikou Prime
catalog.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.

catalog.name: Hystrix
catalog.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

catalog.name: Hystrix Prime
catalog.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.

catalog.name: Knell
catalog.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

catalog.name: Knell Prime
catalog.description: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.

catalog.name: Kohmak
catalog.description: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.

catalog.name: Kompressa
catalog.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

catalog.name: Kompressa Prime
catalog.description: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.

catalog.name: Kraken
catalog.description: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.

catalog.name: Kulstar
catalog.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

catalog.name: Kunai
catalog.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

catalog.name: Kuva Brakk
catalog.description: This Lich-variant semi-automatic hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package. Higher fire rate, magazine capacity and reload speed.

catalog.name: Kuva Kraken
catalog.description: A custom variant that fires three quick shots with a single pull of the trigger, or can alt-fire burst the remainder of its magazine. Higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed.

catalog.name: Kuva Nukor
catalog.description: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.

catalog.name: Kuva Seer
catalog.description: This variant pistol has higher fire rate and magazine capacity. Superior zoom capabilities plus projectiles have a small Corrosive burst.

catalog.name: Kuva Twin Stubbas
catalog.description: Double-fist rapid-fire bursts of pain with these dual-wield variants of the Grineer submachine gun. Higher Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity.

catalog.name: Laetum
catalog.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

catalog.name: Lato
catalog.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

catalog.name: Lato Prime
catalog.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

catalog.name: Lato Vandal
catalog.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.

catalog.name: Lex
catalog.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

catalog.name: Lex Prime
catalog.description: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

catalog.name: Magnus
catalog.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

catalog.name: Magnus Prime
catalog.description: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to give Infinite Ammo for a few seconds.

catalog.name: Mara Detron
catalog.description: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.

catalog.name: Marelok
catalog.description: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.

catalog.name: Mk1-Furis
catalog.description: The MK1-Furis are the standard issue automatic pistol for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Mk1-Kunai
catalog.description: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Nukor
catalog.description: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.

catalog.name: Ocucor
catalog.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

catalog.name: Onos
catalog.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

catalog.name: Pandero
catalog.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

catalog.name: Pandero Prime
catalog.description: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.

catalog.name: Plinx
catalog.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.

catalog.name: Pox
catalog.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.

catalog.name: Prisma Angstrum
catalog.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.

catalog.name: Prisma Twin Gremlins
catalog.description: Fused with prisma crystals, these pristine Grineer sidearms are sure to intimidate any foe.

catalog.name: Pyrana
catalog.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

catalog.name: Pyrana Prime
catalog.description: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.

catalog.name: Quatz
catalog.description: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.

catalog.name: Rakta Ballistica
catalog.description: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.

catalog.name: Riot-848
catalog.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

catalog.name: Sagek Prime
catalog.description: The sidearm of choice for Prime Grineer warriors, Sagek Prime blends Grineer brutality with Orokin aesthetics. When Sagek Prime inflicts a critical hit, its next shot has a chance to gain significant Status Chance.

drops.location: Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A
Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A
Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A

catalog.name: Sancti Castanas
catalog.description: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.

catalog.name: Scyotid
catalog.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

drops.location: Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A
Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A
Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A

catalog.name: Secura Dual Cestra
catalog.description: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.

catalog.name: Seer
catalog.description: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.

catalog.name: Sepulcrum
catalog.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.

catalog.name: Sicarus
catalog.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

catalog.name: Sicarus Prime
catalog.description: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

catalog.name: Sonicor
catalog.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.

catalog.name: Spectra
catalog.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.

catalog.name: Spectra Vandal
catalog.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.

catalog.name: Spira
catalog.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

catalog.name: Spira Prime
catalog.description: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.

catalog.name: Staticor
