catalog.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.

catalog.name: Stubba
catalog.description: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.

catalog.name: Stug
catalog.description: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.

catalog.name: Synoid Gammacor
catalog.description: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.

catalog.name: Talons
catalog.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

catalog.name: Telos Akbolto
catalog.description: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.

catalog.name: Tenet Cycron
catalog.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.

catalog.name: Tenet Detron
catalog.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.

catalog.name: Tenet Diplos
catalog.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

catalog.name: Tenet Plinx
catalog.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.

catalog.name: Tenet Spirex
catalog.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.

catalog.name: Twin Grakatas
catalog.description: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.

catalog.name: Twin Gremlins
catalog.description: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.

catalog.name: Twin Kohmak
catalog.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

catalog.name: Twin Rogga
catalog.description: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.

catalog.name: Twin Vipers
catalog.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.

catalog.name: Twin Vipers Wraith
catalog.description: The uniquely styled Twin Vipers Wraith are a powerful variation on the standard akimbo machine-pistols.

catalog.name: Tysis
catalog.description: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.

catalog.name: Vasto
catalog.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

catalog.name: Vasto Prime
catalog.description: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.

catalog.name: Vaykor Marelok
catalog.description: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.

catalog.name: Velox
catalog.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

catalog.name: Velox Prime
catalog.description: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.

catalog.name: Vesper 77
catalog.description: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.

catalog.name: Viper
catalog.description: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.

catalog.name: Viper Wraith
catalog.description: The uniquely styled Viper Wraith is a powerful variation on the standard machine-pistol.

catalog.name: Zakti
catalog.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

catalog.name: Zakti Prime
catalog.description: A thousand pains, before their end.

catalog.name: Zylok
catalog.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

catalog.name: Zylok Prime
catalog.description: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.

catalog.name: Zymos
catalog.description: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.

catalog.name: Ack & Brunt
catalog.description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

catalog.name: Amanata
catalog.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

catalog.name: Amphis
catalog.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

catalog.name: Anku
catalog.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

catalog.name: Ankyros
catalog.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

catalog.name: Ankyros Prime
catalog.description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

catalog.name: Arca Titron
catalog.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

catalog.name: Argo & Vel
catalog.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

catalog.name: Arum Spinosa
catalog.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

catalog.name: Atterax
catalog.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

catalog.name: Azothane
catalog.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

catalog.name: Bo
catalog.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

catalog.name: Bo Prime
catalog.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

catalog.name: Boltace
catalog.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

catalog.name: Broken Scepter
catalog.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Complete The War Within

catalog.name: Broken War
catalog.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Complete The Second Dream
Cephalon Simaris, Complete The Second Dream

catalog.name: Cadus
catalog.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

catalog.name: Cassowar
catalog.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

catalog.name: Caustacyst
catalog.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

catalog.name: Ceramic Dagger
catalog.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

catalog.name: Cerata
catalog.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

catalog.name: Ceti Lacera
catalog.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.

catalog.name: Cobra & Crane
catalog.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

catalog.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
catalog.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

catalog.name: Coda Caustacyst
catalog.description: The Coda Caustacyst scythe is a force to be reckoned with, the Technocyte virus honing it with improved Damage, Status Chance, and Critical Damage, as well as acid pools with longer duration.

catalog.name: Coda Hirudo
catalog.description: Rip and shred your enemies to pieces with the Coda Hirudo. With improved Damage, Status Chance, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage.

catalog.name: Coda Mire
catalog.description: The Plague Year of 1999 will never be the same. With improved Critical Multipler, Critical Chance, and Status Chance, the Technocyte virus has turned the Coda Mire into a truly horrifying blade.

catalog.name: Coda Motovore
catalog.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

catalog.name: Coda Pathocyst
catalog.description: Enhanced by Technocyte mutations, the Coda Pathocyst comes with increased Damage, Critical Chance, Critical Damage and Status Chance. While in-flight or on contact with the enemy, it will occasionally spawn enhanced, enemy-seeking miasmites.

catalog.name: Corufell
catalog.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

catalog.name: Corufell Prime
catalog.description: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.

catalog.name: Cronus
catalog.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

catalog.name: Dakra Prime
catalog.description: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

catalog.name: Dark Dagger
catalog.description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

catalog.name: Dark Split-Sword
catalog.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

catalog.name: Dark Sword
catalog.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

catalog.name: Destreza
catalog.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

catalog.name: Destreza Prime
catalog.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

catalog.name: Dex Dakra
catalog.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

catalog.name: Dex Nikana
catalog.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

catalog.name: Dorrclave
catalog.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

catalog.name: Dragon Nikana
catalog.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

catalog.name: Dual Cleavers
catalog.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

catalog.name: Dual Ether
catalog.description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

catalog.name: Dual Heat Swords
catalog.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

catalog.name: Dual Ichor
catalog.description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

catalog.name: Dual Kamas
catalog.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

catalog.name: Dual Kamas Prime
catalog.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

catalog.name: Dual Keres
catalog.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

catalog.name: Dual Keres Prime
catalog.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

catalog.name: Dual Raza
catalog.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

catalog.name: Dual Skana
catalog.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

catalog.name: Dual Viciss
catalog.description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

catalog.name: Dual Zoren
catalog.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

catalog.name: Dual Zoren Prime
catalog.description: Axes worthy of an executioner, refined to Orokin perfection.

catalog.name: Edun
catalog.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

catalog.name: Ekhein
catalog.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

catalog.name: Endura
catalog.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

catalog.name: Ether Daggers
catalog.description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Stolen Dreams

catalog.name: Ether Reaper
catalog.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

catalog.name: Ether Sword
catalog.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.

catalog.name: Falcor
catalog.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

catalog.name: Fang
catalog.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

catalog.name: Fang Prime
catalog.description: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

catalog.name: Fragor
catalog.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

catalog.name: Fragor Prime
catalog.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

catalog.name: Furax
catalog.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

catalog.name: Furax Wraith
catalog.description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

catalog.name: Galariak Prime
catalog.description: Orokin-era Grineer plated their scythes with gold as a symbol of dedication to their Golden Lords. Gains a percentage of Critical Chance with each Status Type affecting the target.

drops.location: Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A
Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A
Dark Refractory, Deimos/Recall: Dactolyst (The Perita Rebellion), Rotation A

catalog.name: Galatine
catalog.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

catalog.name: Galatine Prime
catalog.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

catalog.name: Galvacord
catalog.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

catalog.name: Gazal Machete
catalog.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.

catalog.name: Ghoulsaw
catalog.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

catalog.name: Glaive
catalog.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

catalog.name: Glaive Prime
catalog.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

catalog.name: Gram
catalog.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

catalog.name: Gram Prime
catalog.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

catalog.name: Guandao
catalog.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

catalog.name: Guandao Prime
catalog.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

catalog.name: Gunsen
catalog.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

catalog.name: Gunsen Prime
catalog.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.

catalog.name: Halikar
catalog.description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

catalog.name: Halikar Wraith
catalog.description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

catalog.name: Harmony
catalog.description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

catalog.name: Hate
catalog.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

catalog.name: Heat Dagger
catalog.description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

catalog.name: Heat Sword
catalog.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

catalog.name: Heliocor
catalog.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

catalog.name: Hespar
catalog.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

drops.location: Zariman Ten Zero (Level  90 - 95 Zariman Bounty), Rotation C

catalog.name: Hirudo
catalog.description: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.

catalog.name: Innodem
catalog.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

catalog.name: Jat Kittag
catalog.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

catalog.name: Jat Kusar
catalog.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

catalog.name: Jaw Sword
catalog.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

catalog.name: Kama
catalog.description: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

catalog.name: Karyst
catalog.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Karyst Prime
catalog.description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.

catalog.name: Keratinos
catalog.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

catalog.name: Kesheg
catalog.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

catalog.name: Kestrel
catalog.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

catalog.name: Kestrel Prime
catalog.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.

catalog.name: Kogake
catalog.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

catalog.name: Kogake Prime
catalog.description: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.

catalog.name: Korrudo
catalog.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

catalog.name: Korumm
catalog.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.

catalog.name: Kreska
catalog.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.

catalog.name: Krohkur
catalog.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

catalog.name: Kronen
catalog.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

catalog.name: Kronen Prime
catalog.description: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.

catalog.name: Kuva Ghoulsaw
catalog.description: The addition of Kuva has forged the savage Ghoulsaw into an even more brutal weapon, allowing for faster attacks.

catalog.name: Kuva Shildeg
catalog.description: A crushing, killing, rocket-powered stab-hammer. Grineer, naturally.

catalog.name: Lacera
catalog.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

catalog.name: Lecta
catalog.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

catalog.name: Lesion
catalog.description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

catalog.name: Machete
catalog.description: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Daily Tribute

catalog.name: Machete Wraith
catalog.description: A different take on a familiar combat knife, the Machete Wraith features unique styling.

catalog.name: Magistar
catalog.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

catalog.name: Masseter
catalog.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

catalog.name: Masseter Prime
catalog.description: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.

catalog.name: Mios
catalog.description: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.

catalog.name: Mire
catalog.description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.

catalog.name: Mk1-Bo
catalog.description: The MK1-Bo is the standard issue staff weapon for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Mk1-Furax
catalog.description: The MK1-Furax is the standard issue fist weapon for all Tenno.

catalog.name: Nami Skyla
catalog.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

catalog.name: Nami Skyla Prime
catalog.description: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.

catalog.name: Nami Solo
catalog.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

catalog.name: Nepheri
catalog.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

catalog.name: Nikana
catalog.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

catalog.name: Nikana Prime
catalog.description: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.

catalog.name: Ninkondi
catalog.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

catalog.name: Ninkondi Prime
catalog.description: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.

catalog.name: Obex
catalog.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.

catalog.name: Ohma
catalog.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

catalog.name: Okina
catalog.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

catalog.name: Okina Prime
catalog.description: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.

catalog.name: Orthos
catalog.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

catalog.name: Orthos Prime
catalog.description: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.

catalog.name: Orvius
catalog.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Complete The War Within

catalog.name: Pangolin Prime
catalog.description: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.

catalog.name: Pangolin Sword
catalog.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

catalog.name: Paracesis
catalog.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

catalog.name: Pathocyst
catalog.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.

catalog.name: Pennant
catalog.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

catalog.name: Plasma Sword
catalog.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

catalog.name: Praedos
catalog.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.

catalog.name: Pride
catalog.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

catalog.name: Prisma Dual Cleavers
catalog.description: Blades of energized prisma crystal make these ornamental cleavers cut as sharply as they look.

catalog.name: Prisma Machete
catalog.description: The addition of Prisma Crystal allows this otherwise barbaric weapon to elegantly hack through any foe.

catalog.name: Prisma Obex
catalog.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.

catalog.name: Prisma Ohma
catalog.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.

catalog.name: Prisma Skana
catalog.description: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.

catalog.name: Prova
catalog.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.

catalog.name: Prova Vandal
catalog.description: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.

catalog.name: Pulmonars
catalog.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

catalog.name: Pupacyst
catalog.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

catalog.name: Quassus
catalog.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

drops.location: Deimos/Cambion Drift (Level 100 - 100 Cambion Drift Bounty), Rotation A

catalog.name: Quassus Prime
catalog.description: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.

catalog.name: Rakta Dark Dagger
catalog.description: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.

catalog.name: Reaper Prime
catalog.description: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.

catalog.name: Redeemer
catalog.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

catalog.name: Redeemer Prime
catalog.description: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.

catalog.name: Ripkas
catalog.description: Motorized saw claw weapon.

catalog.name: Rumblejack
catalog.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.

catalog.name: Ruvox
catalog.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

catalog.name: Sampotes
catalog.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

catalog.name: Sancti Magistar
catalog.description: Each charged attack turns the enemy’s pain into a healing pulse that washes over allies. Also, creates resistance to Status Effects when held.

catalog.name: Sarofang
catalog.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.

catalog.name: Sarofang Prime
catalog.description: Voruna Prime's signature axe is adorned with Orokin gold. She personally ensured that the former owners would have no further use for it.

catalog.name: Sarpa
catalog.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

catalog.name: Scindo
catalog.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

catalog.name: Scindo Prime
catalog.description: An ancient executioners weapon, the honor of decapitation by the Scindo Prime was reserved for the Orokin's most respected enemies.

catalog.name: Scoliac
catalog.description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.

catalog.name: Secura Lecta
catalog.description: Whip the enemy out of their ill-gotten gains; double credit drops on kills.

catalog.name: Serro
catalog.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

catalog.name: Shaku
catalog.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

catalog.name: Sheev
catalog.description: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.

catalog.name: Sibear
catalog.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

catalog.name: Sigma & Octantis
catalog.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Daily Tribute

catalog.name: Silva & Aegis
catalog.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

catalog.name: Silva & Aegis Prime
catalog.description: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.

catalog.name: Skana
catalog.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

catalog.name: Skana Prime
catalog.description: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.

catalog.name: Skiajati
catalog.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

catalog.name: Slaytra
catalog.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.

catalog.name: Spinnerex
catalog.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

drops.location: Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A
Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A
Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A
Duviri Murmur Invasion Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation A

catalog.name: Stropha
catalog.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.

catalog.name: Sun & Moon
catalog.description: Teshin's twin blades.

catalog.name: Syam
catalog.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

catalog.name: Sydon
catalog.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

catalog.name: Synoid Heliocor
catalog.description: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.

catalog.name: Tak & Lug
catalog.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

catalog.name: Tatsu
catalog.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.

catalog.name: Tatsu Prime
catalog.description: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.

catalog.name: Tekko
catalog.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

catalog.name: Tekko Prime
catalog.description: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.

catalog.name: Telos Boltace
catalog.description: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way.

catalog.name: Tenet Agendus
catalog.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

catalog.name: Tenet Exec
catalog.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

catalog.name: Tenet Grigori
catalog.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

catalog.name: Tenet Livia
catalog.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

catalog.name: Thalys
catalog.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.

catalog.name: Tipedo
catalog.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

catalog.name: Tipedo Prime
catalog.description: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.

catalog.name: Tonbo
catalog.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

catalog.name: Tonkkatt
catalog.description: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.

catalog.name: Twin Basolk
catalog.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

catalog.name: Twin Krohkur
catalog.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

catalog.name: Vastilok
catalog.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

catalog.name: Vaykor Sydon
catalog.description: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.

catalog.name: Venato
catalog.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

catalog.name: Venato Prime
catalog.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against 'common enemies' of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.

catalog.name: Venka
catalog.description: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.

catalog.name: Venka Prime
catalog.description: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.

catalog.name: Verdilac
catalog.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

catalog.name: Vericres
catalog.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

catalog.name: Vitrica
catalog.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

catalog.name: Volnus
catalog.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

catalog.name: Volnus Prime
catalog.description: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.

catalog.name: War
catalog.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

catalog.name: War Prime
catalog.description: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.

catalog.name: Wolf Sledge
catalog.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

catalog.name: Wrath
catalog.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

catalog.name: Xoris
catalog.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through The Deadlock Protocol
Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through The Deadlock Protocol
Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through The Deadlock Protocol
Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through The Deadlock Protocol

catalog.name: Zenistar
catalog.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.

drops.location: Cephalon Simaris, Unlock through Daily Tribute

catalog.name: Arbucep
catalog.description: Nokko’s signature archgun fires six homing missiles, each bearing a payload of one of the six combined elements which detonate in an area upon impact.

drops.location: Nokko: Corporate Restructuring (Steel Path), Rotation C
Nokko: Corporate Restructuring (Steel Path), Rotation C
Nokko: Critter Liberation Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation C
Nokko: Weed The Gardens Rewards (Steel Path), Rotation C

catalog.name: Cortege
catalog.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy flamethrower with surprising range. Secondary fire launches three projectiles in a fan pattern that explode, leaving a damaging area of effect for a short duration.

catalog.name: Corvas
catalog.description: When fully charged, this flak cannon delivers a devastating shot. Perfect for taking down fast-moving interceptors.

catalog.name: Corvas Prime
catalog.description: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.

catalog.name: Cyngas
catalog.description: Unload deadly accurate bursts of mayhem.

catalog.name: Dual Decurion
catalog.description: Delivering twin streams of highly accurate, rapid-fire ordnance, the Decurion are specifically designed for combat in the vacuum of space.

catalog.name: Fluctus
catalog.description: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.

catalog.name: Grattler
catalog.description: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.

catalog.name: Imperator
catalog.description: A long range rifle capable of firing in space, the Imperator's versatility makes it an ideal weapon for space combat.

catalog.name: Imperator Vandal
catalog.description: The Imperator Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the barrel.

catalog.name: Kuva Ayanga
catalog.description: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.

catalog.name: Kuva Grattler
catalog.description: Reconfigured for maximum lethality, the Kuva Grattler still shatters targets with explosive shells, but now reaches maximum fire-rate instantaneously.

catalog.name: Larkspur
catalog.description: From death blooms the Larkspur. A unique and menacing Archgun with a wild initial attack that locks onto a target then chains other targets close to the first. It also sports an explosive projectile mode. In Hildryn's grip the Larkspur carries more reserve ammo.

catalog.name: Larkspur Prime
catalog.description: Embrace pandemonium. Chainfire and explosive potential meet in Larkspur Prime. Hildryn packs more ammo when she wields this mighty weapon.

catalog.name: Mandonel
catalog.description: Mandonel fires <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage projectiles. Partially charged shots release a spread and fully charged shots release a beam that dissolves into a radiation field. Projectiles that pass through the field are empowered.

drops.location: Deimos/Albrecht's Laboratories (Level  95 - 100 Entrati Lab Bounty), Rotation C

catalog.name: Mausolon
catalog.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Punishing automatic primary fire and a secondary mode that charges up to unleash a destructive beam of energy with a large explosion at point of impact.

catalog.name: Morgha
catalog.description: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.

catalog.name: Phaedra
catalog.description: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.

catalog.name: Prisma Dual Decurions
catalog.description: Colder than space and less forgiving, Prisma crystals bring elite efficiency to the already sleek Dual Decurion. Requiring the lightest of touches to reload, these twin archguns prove that heavy weaponry can still possess elegance.

catalog.name: Velocitus
catalog.description: When fully charged, the magnetized barrel of the Velocitus accelerates a metal slug to tremendous speeds, piercing hulls and obliterating armor.

catalog.name: Agkuza
catalog.description: Tear apart incoming enemies with this massive hooked blade.

catalog.name: Centaur
catalog.description: Part sword, part shield, the Centaur excels at charging headlong into enemy fire.

catalog.name: Kaszas
catalog.description: Become an angel of death, with this Archwing scythe.

catalog.name: Knux
catalog.description: Gallium-alloy gauntlets for close-range Archwing combat. Designed by the infamous Tyl Regor.

catalog.name: Onorix
catalog.description: This laser bladed battle-axe easily hacks through a ship's defenses and the forces protecting it.

catalog.name: Prisma Veritux
catalog.description: A rare object of beauty, this Archwing sword has been sheathed in prisma crystal and baptized in the Void’s energy.

catalog.name: Rathbone
catalog.description: Using Archwing's jets for thrust, this massive hammer crushes anything in its path.

catalog.name: Veritux
catalog.description: Weightless space turns this impossibly massive sword into an agile instrument of destruction.

catalog.name: Amesha
catalog.description: Transform into a winged guardian.

abilities.name: Watchful Swarm
abilities.description: Tiny drones orbit the Warframe or an ally, and intercept enemy fire.

abilities.name: Benevolent Decoy
abilities.description: Creates beacons that draw enemy fire, converting the damage into healing pulses.

abilities.name: Warding Grace
abilities.description: Renders the Warframe and nearby allies immune to Status Effects, while slowing nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Vengeful Rush
abilities.description: All damage taken is transformed into Energy, while abilities gain enhanced Range, Duration and Power. Affects the Warframe and nearby allies.

catalog.name: Elytron
catalog.description: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.

abilities.name: Bloomer
abilities.description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.

abilities.name: Core Vent
abilities.description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.

abilities.name: Thumper
abilities.description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.

abilities.name: Warhead
abilities.description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.

catalog.name: Itzal
